name: competition_config_20261122

candidate_pool.rule: union(dense_mxbai top-100, frozen full-query CE top-100) minus frozen top-10, ordered by best rank in either source (dense first on ties), keep 20

actions: slot 1..10 x 20 candidates; judged pairs ordered head-first (slot, then prior)

judge.option_scoring: softmax over single-token ids of A/B/C at the last position
judge.prompt: Choose which passage is more relevant to the question. Output A or B. Output C if tied.

decision: eligible iff the challenger is argmax in BOTH orders and merged challenger prob > 0.5; execute the single eligible swap with the largest merged probability; otherwise keep the frozen ranking

dev_result.source: replay of results/replacement_v2/expanded3_fixed_dev.json at k=6, head-first ordering

learned_selector_cv.note: 5-fold CV over dev queries; +0.0036 [-0.0034,+0.0110] over the frozen rule

caveat: k=6 was chosen after seeing the budget curve; the gain is significant vs the frozen system but the paired advantage over the tail arm includes zero (+0.0056 [-0.0009,+0.0127]).
